assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one photorealistic catalog product photograph for the Reshoot eight-angle linen-doll turntable. Image 1 (back photograph) is the EDIT TARGET and primary identity, back-of-dress seam, hairstyle, scale and lighting reference. Image 2 is the matching existing SIDE PROFILE, supporting geometry reference only. Change only the doll's rotation to the requested REAR THREE-QUARTER view, precisely halfway between those two existing views. This must be a view of the BACK AND SIDE, not a front three-quarter view and not a strict back view. The broad back of the head and back of dress with vertical center-back seam must be visible; eyes, smile and front bodice are hidden. Rotate the whole doll rigidly: head, torso, arms and feet turn together, no independent head turn or limb changes. Preserve the same warm ivory linen doll, cream twisted-yarn pigtails, hairstyle center part and strand thickness, dress stitching at neck, sleeves, waist and hem, fine cloth texture, proportions and relaxed arm pose. Match the existing full-body square framing exactly: centered doll, crown about 6% below top, soles about 6% above bottom, same product scale and camera height, whole body visible without crop. Fixed studio: large softbox ABOVE CAMERA LEFT, highlights on upper/left-facing surfaces and restrained shading to the right, soft neutral-gray floor/contact shadow cast to SCREEN RIGHT from feet. Do not rotate or mirror the light, floor shadow, camera, backdrop or exposure with the doll. Match the back reference's cream colors, warm neutral white balance and soft natural contrast. Uniform pure white #FFFFFF seamless floor and backdrop outside localized shadow, all edges white, no horizon, vignette, haze, props, borders, labels, text, logos or panels. Deliver ONE high-resolution SQUARE 1254 by 1254 product photograph, not a contact sheet or website screenshot. Maintain consistent identity and precise intermediate rotation, with physically correct fixed camera-left illumination. Do not generate a flat horizontal mirror. Requested angle: BACK-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER, azimuth 135 degrees in the front → right-facing profile → back sequence. The doll faces diagonally AWAY FROM CAMERA toward SCREEN RIGHT. Show mostly the back, plus the right-facing side, halfway from the right-profile reference (nose to screen right) toward the straight-back target. Back-of-head yarn and back dress seam dominate; any face is concealed. The center-back seam should be foreshortened and displaced slightly toward screen left, rather than remaining in a perfectly straight rear pose.
